key_insight: Foundational r2SCAN-trained MLIPs can replace extra DFT steps to correct formation energies toward experiment, and their latent features enable an even better delta-learning refinement.
engineering_relevance: This offers a faster, open, and more accurate way to rank crystal stability for materials discovery and screening workflows.
method: Compare MC3D thermodynamic stability against OQMD, Materials Project, and experimental formation enthalpies
Use PET-OMATPES foundational MLIP energies to correct DFT formation energies without additional DFT calculations
Train delta-learning models on MLIP latent features to further reduce error below 50 meV/atom
evidence_signal: The abstract reports more than a 40% MAE reduction relative to GGA and final errors below 50 meV/atom, approaching experimental uncertainty.
watch_item: Performance may depend on the quality and domain coverage of the foundational MLIP and on careful regularization to avoid distorting relative phase stability.
paper_title: Correcting DFT formation energies towards experimental accuracy using foundational MLIPs and latent-feature delta-learning
